long_biography.plain_text:
Architect and property developer Wojciech Fabiński began his long maritime involvement as a student, helping three friends build an ocean-going sailing boat. Martial law left him in Poland while its crew was abroad. He later recovered the vessel in Marseille, restored it and donated it to the Polish Scouting Association for youth voyages.

His next maritime project passed through four designs over two decades before a new schooner was completed. As president of Klub Sportowy Nad Wigrami, Fabiński placed it with the sports organisation for Baltic youth voyages and planned polar expeditions. The club became its operator, with young crews intended for both regional and longer passages.
long_biography.html:
Architect and property developer Wojciech Fabiński began his long maritime involvement as a student, helping three friends build an ocean-going sailing boat. Martial law left him in Poland while its crew was abroad. He later recovered the vessel in Marseille, restored it and donated it to the Polish Scouting Association for youth voyages.

His next maritime project passed through four designs over two decades before a new schooner was completed. As president of Klub Sportowy Nad Wigrami, Fabiński placed it with the sports organisation for Baltic youth voyages and planned polar expeditions. The club became its operator, with young crews intended for both regional and longer passages.

An obituary notice and independent organisational and regional memorials document Fabiński's death in September 2019.
